name: What are the common causes of premature roof aging in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: What are the common causes of premature roof aging in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the DFW area, common causes of premature roof aging include intense sun exposure, hailstorms, and high winds. The extreme temperatures and frequent severe weather events in this region can accelerate wear and tear on roofing materials, leading to earlier deterioration than roofs in milder climates. Regular inspections are crucial to monitor and address these specific regional stressors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Intense sun, hailstorms, and high winds in DFW accelerate roof aging. Regular inspections are crucial.
